title: Cerebral Citadel Armour

sources.title: Illithid Protection
markers: | summary = '''Illithid Protection''' is a passive feature that provides a bit of mind protection but only if infested by a tadpole.

sources.title: Frightened Immunity
markers: | summary = '''Frightened Immunity''' is a passive feature that keeps the wearer brave.

summary: Heavy armour with 18 AC and Stealth disadvantage. The item source describes tadpole-related mental protection.

fields.Illithid Protection: A tadpole-infected wearer gains +1 to Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.
fields.Frightened Immunity: The listed passive grants Frightened immunity. The item summary groups this with the tadpole requirement, while the passive describes immunity without that restriction.
fields.Base value: 3200 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.
fields.Armour Class: Heavy armour with AC 18 and disadvantage on Stealth checks.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions. Expanded the card from the pinned item and linked gameplay evidence.
